title: TTY service speaks PTS_* verbs, retire TTY_* labels
completion_summary: feat(tty): speak unified PTS_* verbs; retire TTY_* labels. Replaced TTY_CTL, TTY_SET_FG, TTY_GET_FG, TTY_READ_REQUEST, TTY_POLL_QUERY dispatch with postcard-serialized PTS_GET_TERMIOS, PTS_SET_TERMIOS, PTS_SET_PGRP, PTS_GET_PGRP, PTS_READ, PTS_POLL, PTS_WRITE. Added cluu_proto + postcard deps. TTY_REGISTER kept as local registration. TTY_WRITE_SYNC kept for compatibility. context.rs uses PTS_READ_LABEL in reply.
acceptance_criteria: TTY_* label dispatch replaced with PTS_* label dispatch from cluu_proto::pts
Handler bodies mirror cluuterm's PTS_* implementations (same line discipline, same routing helpers)
TTY service holds per-/dev/tty<n> LineDiscipline instances
Legacy TTY_* handler arms deleted from main.rs
TTY_* const definitions deleted from protocol.rs
bash scripts/harness_run.sh boots, Ctrl+Alt+F2 shows text-VT with shell prompt
